summary: V6.0 Radar de Condominios — full backend + frontend testing. Backend: 17 passed / 1 skipped (no leads in DB to validate mega autoflag — OSINT live returned 0 results as expected per agent context note). Frontend: 5 condo pages render correctly with empty states, all required data-testid present, sidebar group header '📡 RADAR DE CONDOMINIOS' visible with all 5 nav items, Config page shows 4 stat cards + OSINT LIVE status + Ejecutar TODO + Guardar buttons. No critical issues found.

minor.issue: Could not validate num_casas_estimado>=200 -> es_mega=true autoflag at runtime because no leads exist in DB (OSINT returned 0); code review of server.py:8056-8060 confirms logic is correct. Recommend main agent insert a seed lead for future regression validation.

action_items: (Optional) Seed at least one condo_lead document so future regression runs can exercise the num_casas_estimado>=200 -> es_mega=true autoflag PATCH path end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 8268 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Strongly recommend splitting V6.0 RADAR DE CONDOMINIOS (lines 7607-8164) into a separate module (e.g., backend/routers/condo_radar.py).

_condo_extract_phones regex is overly permissive (matches 7+ digit sequences with optional country code) — may produce false positives from price/ID strings in snippets. Consider stricter MX phone validation (require 10 normalized digits AND prefix in a whitelist like 442, 55, etc.).
_condo_run_analista passes raw posts_for_llm as str(...) (line 7828). This is fragile; use json.dumps for stable LLM input and reliable JSON-array output parsing.
POST /api/condo/run (full pipeline) has no timeout/queue guard — three sequential live OSINT actors can take several minutes and block the worker. Consider moving to BackgroundTasks or a job queue.

DELETE /api/condo/alertas/{id} and /condo/grupos/{id} return 200 with ok=false for non-existent ids; standard REST would return 404. Minor consistency issue with /condo/leads/{id} PATCH which does raise 404.
seed_data_creation: None. condo_config 'default' document is auto-created by first GET. No leads/alertas/grupos seeded — OSINT live pipeline executed but Apify returned 0 organic results for Querétaro queries at test time (acknowledged in agent_to_agent_context_note).
